name: Tomata Soup
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: peck of ripe tomatas
ingredients.originalText: half a peck of ripe tomatas

instructions.text: Cut up the fore-leg of beef into small pieces
Put the meat with the bones into a soup-pot, and cover it with a gallon of water
Season it with pepper, and a little salt
Have ready half a peck of ripe tomatas cut up small; and when the soup is boiling thoroughly, put them in with all their juice
Add six onions sliced, and some crusts of bread cut small
Boil the soup slowly for six hours or more
When done, strain it through a cullender
Put into the tureen some pieces of bread cut into dice or small squares, and pour the soup upon it

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut up the fore-leg of beef into small pieces
2. Put the meat with the bones into a soup-pot, and cover it with a gallon of water
3. Season it with pepper, and a little salt
4. Boil and skim it well
5. Have ready half a peck of ripe tomatas cut up small; and when the soup is boiling thoroughly, put them in with all their juice
6. Add six onions sliced, and some crusts of bread cut small
7. Boil the soup slowly for six hours or more
8. When done, strain it through a cullender
9. Put into the tureen some pieces of bread cut into dice or small squares, and pour the soup upon it
